newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks fall, close weak in slack trading.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks fall, close weak in slack trading.

text.p: Shares on the Caracas Stock Exchange fell across-the-board in sluggish trade as the market proved unable to shake off seasonal lethargy, brokers said.
According to preliminary figures from the exchange, the market's 19-share index fell 1.71 percent to 5,993.17 as five stocks rose, 26 slipped and six closed flat.
"The market was terrible today, the only stock that stood out was Fondo de Valores Immobiliarios (FVI)," one broker said.
FVI accounted for over half of today's trade after its B shares debuted following a capital increase.
FVI B shares opened at 30 bolivars and closed at 34.60 bolivars.

Among leading stocks, telephone company CANTV rose 20.00 bolivars to 1830.00 bolivars, electric utility Electricidad de Caracas slipped 5.00 bolivars to 502.00 bolivars, leading bank Banco Provincial lost 20.00 bolivars to close at 1180.00 bolivars and agroindustrial company Mavesa slipped 2.00 bolivars to 135.00 bolivars.
A total of 2.681 billion bolivars ($5.7 million) changed hands, the exchange said.
